normal.name: Harry
normal.text: No Man's Sky is a game I really want to like but it doesn't matter how many updates it gets, it still feels shallow. What I enjoy in space games is trading and working my way up. In NMS, while trading exists... the motivation just isn't there. Even after a few planets the game is like BAM! Here's a free freighter! Guess I'm projecting my ideal space game on it, and I should just accept it's not for me. I do enjoy seeing what each update brings at least. #nomanssky #videogames
